verdict.rationale: Agents can discover tools programmatically within a connected MCP server: `mcpClient.tools()` automatically loads all available tools, and each app has its own dedicated MCP server. A machine-readable catalog also exists. The llms.txt app marketplace lists 3,223 apps, and per-app .md pages give tool counts and connection details. Pipedream documents a REST API and SDKs for the Connect service, but the evidence never shows a documented endpoint for searching or listing the app/server registry. Catalog-level discovery therefore relies on scraping llms.txt or markdown pages. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented registry/catalog API for listing and searching apps and servers, filtering or metadata query semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
